evidence.title: myTodo: A full-stack Turborepo Monorepo Starter

name: myTodo
summary: Turborepo monorepo starter with a Fastify GraphQL API and a React plus Vite dashboard app, wired together by shared packages.
description: An example full-stack TypeScript monorepo: a GraphQL API (Fastify, GraphQL Yoga, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Better Auth, Resend email) and a React dashboard (Vite, TanStack Router, Apollo Client, shadcn/ui). Shared packages cover the Prisma database layer, GraphQL schema and codegen, Zod validation, email templates and configs; Docker-ready with Jest and Vitest.
contains: GraphQL API: Fastify + GraphQL Yoga + Prisma + PostgreSQL
React dashboard: Vite + TanStack Router + Apollo Client + shadcn/ui
auth with Better Auth, email templates via Maizzle + Resend
shared packages: database, GraphQL schema and codegen, Zod validation, logger, configs
